contracts.rules: Ten contracts enforce exhaustive inward layers, neutral application dependencies, adapters excluded from application orchestration, SDK ownership, adapter independence, root facade isolation and recursive sibling acyclicity

Known inner effect calls/imports and canonical facade imports are rejected by scripts/check_architecture.py; positive/negative fixtures cover aliases, local/type-only imports, module coverage, layer violations, cycles, lazy exports and isolated SDK-free inner imports

checks.command: uv run python scripts/check_architecture.py && uv run pytest tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: All positive and negative dependency/effect cases pass
Zero unexplained survivors and stale equivalents
Full live suite passes with owned cleanup
Documentation, public signatures and relative links pass

documentation: Update architecture/engineering memory and canonical implementation references; preserve public guides and dated history.
